newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Ashanti plans Zimbabwe depositary receipts.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti plans Zimbabwe depositary receipts.

text.p: Ashanti Goldfields has created a Zimbabwe depositary receipt facility to improve the volume of trading of its shares on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The facility would be on the basis of 100 Zimbabwe Depositary Receipts (ZDRs) for every one Ashanti share deposited.

The company said since its listing on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE) last May, its shares had traded in a range between Z$80 and Z$135, which represented a discount to the Ashanti share price on other stock exchanges.
It said this had been partly due to the small number of Ashanti shares on the Zimbabwean register which had made its stock relatively difficult to trade on the local bourse.
Ashanti has about 900,000 shares quoted on the ZSE. It has a total of 90.3 million shares in issue. It is also listed in London, Sydney, Toronto, New York and Accra.

"In an attempt to facilitate trading of Ashanti equity on the ZSE, Ashanti has created a facility (the ZDR facility) to enable shareholders on the Zimbabwe register to exchange each Ashanti share held by them for 100 Ashanti ZDR's," it said.

"If all Ashanti shareholders on the ZSE opt to convert their Ashanti shares into ZDR's, it is anticipated that the volume of trading in Ashanti will increase as a result of the fact that shareholders will have more Ashanti securities in which to deal".
The Ashanti ZDRs will be listed on the ZSE on May 16 and it is anticipated that the price of a ZDR will be about one hundredth of the current trading price of Ashanti shares on the ZSE.
Ashanti shares closed Wednesday's trading session at Z$100.
